text.description_html:
6" x 28" Solid Brass Extra Large Push Plate

Commercial size push plate, 6" wide x 28" high. Perfect for industrial or commercial use. It covers a larger surface area for greater door protection. From factories to restaurants, if you have high traffic doors, this extra tall push plate is the one you want.

This extra large commercial push plate, which is 6" wide x 28" tall, (.050" Thick), is made of Solid Brass.

Perfect for industrial or commercial use. It covers a larger surface area for greater door protection. From factories to restaurants, if you have high traffic doors, this extra tall push plate is the one you want.

Available in Polished Brass Finish only, this push plate includes matching finish mounting screws. It will last for many hard years of use.

Specifications

  • Width: 6"
  • Height: 28"
  • Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws
  • Finish: Polished Brass

*Sold Individually.
